# Browser visual QA artwork

`amazing-man-14.jpg` is the publicly displayed cover thumbnail of **Amazing-Man Comics #14 (July 1940)**, art credited to Lew Glanzman. It was downloaded from [Comic Book Plus's issue page](https://comicbookplus.com/?dlid=34046), whose public thumbnail is https://box01.comicbookplus.com/viewer/2c/2ca4f6119be7e3c4b245f913c3ab9bb7/largethumb.jpg . No login or full-book download was used.

[Wikimedia Commons's description](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amazing_man_14.jpg) identifies the cover as public domain in the United States due to non-renewal. That page is the attribution/licensing reference; the fixture bytes come from Comic Book Plus's public thumbnail.

Only the first six synthetic test records share this reference cover to test actual artwork rendering. The metadata is deliberately generated test data and does not identify the cover's contents. Remaining records use generated calibration images for cache/load tests. No owner collection, private cover, personal image, or AI-generated artwork is included. This fixture is outside public/ and is not bundled into the PWA or preloaded into a real collection. Browser tests read it locally, without network reliance.
